prerequisites: It is recommended that the student has taken the Mathematics subjects of the Science and Technology modality of Baccalaureate.

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to solve mathematical problems that may arise in engineering. Aptitude to apply knowledge about: linear algebra; geometry; differential geometry; differential and integral calculus; differential and partial differential equations; numerical methods; numerical algorithmics; statistics and optimization.

syllabus_topics: Block I. Differential calculus of functions of several variables.
Block II. Integral calculus of functions of several variables.
assessment_rules: The final grade is the weighted average of the evaluation activities' grades, provided the minimum grade for each activity has been met. To pass the course, the weighted average must be 5 or higher. If one or more evaluation activities do not meet the minimum grade, the final grade cannot exceed 4.9. Control I and Control II require a minimum grade of 3. In the extraordinary session, students will only re-take re-evaluable activities for which they did not achieve the minimum grade, and the final grade calculation will follow the same rules.
